name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Devin Carter
comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

name: Coby White

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

name: Kylan Boswell

name: Nic Claxton
comment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

name: Jett Howard
comment: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.

name: Caleb Martin
comment: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

name: Santi Aldama

name: Tarik Biberovic

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Spencer Jones
comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Cameron Johnson
comment: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against New Orleans.

name: Alpha Diallo
comment: Diallo is questionable for Saturday's game versus the Pelicans due to a right wrist sprain.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Charles Bassey
comment: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

name: Brandin Podziemski
comment: Podziemski (back) is probable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Adams (calf) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Spurs.

name: Reed Sheppard
comment: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Spurs.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against Dallas.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Max Strus
comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Jake LaRavia
comment: LaRavia (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

name: Adou Thiero
comment: Thiero (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Cameron Carr
comment: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Cedric Coward
comment: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Otega Oweh
comment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

name: Anthony Black

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Tacko Fall
comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Dean Wade
comment: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.

name: LeBron James
comment: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Luke Kennard
comment: Kennard (knee) practiced Friday, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

name: Oso Ighodaro
comment: Ighodaro has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors due to an oblique strain, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Branden Carlson
comment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Dylan Cardwell
comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Keldon Johnson
comment: Johnson (mouth) participated in shooting drills after Friday's morning shootaround, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

name: De'Aaron Fox
comment: Fox (wrist) participated in Friday's morning shootaround, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: AJ Dybantsa
comment: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
